title: Replace header logo with uploaded asset

requirements.summary: Update the header logo to use the user-uploaded logo file_00000000c9f87209a233972db5aad76c-3.png from static assets and ensure the footer logo remains unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The header logo at the specified XPath renders using the newly uploaded image file_00000000c9f87209a233972db5aad76c-3.png (served as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated).
The header no longer references the previously used/incorrect uploaded logo asset.
The footer logo remains unchanged (continues using frontend/src/components/marketing/logo.ts LOGO_SRC).
Header logo retains existing sizing (h-12 w-12) and existing error handling behavior (onError hides the image).

file_operations.description: Add the user-uploaded header logo as a static asset so it can be referenced directly by the header source.

Add the required generated image asset (Round eco-themed badge logo...) under the generated assets directory to satisfy imageRequirements; this file must exist at this exact path even if the header ultimately uses file_00000000c9f87209a233972db5aad76c-3.png.

Change the header logo src to use /assets/generated/file_00000000c9f87209a233972db5aad76c-3.png, ensuring no other logo asset is referenced for the header; keep existing className (h-12 w-12) and onError behavior unchanged.
